review.imagery: 40 gallery entries include 8 dated site photographs. All 22 primary assets, the complete 40-page brochure index, 54 native resources and eight dated September 2026 photographs were visually reviewed. Two lower-resolution primary crops, textures, generic lifestyle imagery and repeated scene crops were excluded. Twelve brochure scenes add project-branded lobby, clubhouse, home and gym views. Cross-release SHA-256 evidence identifies shared Sunset Bay 2/3/4 architectural and interior concepts. Each selected file is independently published in this project’s own source. Shared renders retain concept scope. Historical photographs retain their original project history attribution.
review.floorPlans: All six whole physical pages 2–7 were visually reviewed on two contacts. The top residential sheet retains the printed 1/2/3 BR categories. Ground and podium 1 remain unavailable in this source. The inspected Silver Oak project page exposes no open floor-plan section. No home area or missing level was inferred or borrowed. Six complete building drawings retain the grouped levels, unit-category legends and rooftop layout. The retrieved packet omits ground and podium 1. No individual saleable home areas are printed. Confirm detailed home sheets, contractual areas and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole original brochure map 9 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. All twelve selected estimates follow its printed schedule. The unnamed metro, source-era La Mer label, approximate access and proposed island context remain qualified. No explicit target coordinates occur in the official named-place embed.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and historical September 2026 construction pages retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original branded brochures and plan packets retain actual Mitchell’s, REMapp or Reelly host attribution. Whole sheets, notices and source bytes remain intact. Protected researched records remain preserved.

unavailable: Individual home sheets and contractual saleable areas, ground and podium 1 drawings, release-specific differences from shared architectural/interior concepts, the named nearest metro station, exact visitor entrance, current certified progress and final specifications remain unavailable or unverified.
